Page 1
 Peak_Trade - Full-Core Execution Autonomy
 Authority chain, live-path state and completion gaps | Baseline origin/main 54ae6a0a4
Evidence basis: This document is a frozen working snapshot based solely on the read-only adjudication
outputs supplied in the conversation. Canonical baseline: origin/main
54ae6a0a4ea11a527144efab43f7cf4a8d64bc2d. Master Runbook is treated as canonical authority; Map
of Truth as navigation only. No missing facts are reconstructed from plausibility.
1. Purpose
This track covers the path from the already selected instrument and deterministic trading decision to risk sizing, canonical
intent, admission, safety, execution port, wire send, venue lifecycle, and reconciliation. It is independent of the
Learning/DDO track.

3. What 'full autonomy' means here
Full autonomy does not require an AI to own the trading decision or execution admission. The desired architecture is
deterministic authority plus autonomous orchestration: the core decides; risk and admission authorize; an eventual
orchestrator may advance the workflow but may not mint new trading, ranking, risk, or wire authority.

Cap 2.3 Selection -> Cap 2.4 Bind -> Market Data -> Master V2 / Double Play -> STEP-29P -> Replay Safety ->
STEP-29Q PLAN_ONLY -> Mapper -> SimulatedExecutionPortV1 -> Accounting / Portfolio / Evidence.
